blocks.content: FCI supplies food grains to states for distribution through the Targeted Public Distribution System (TPDS), which provides subsidized food to eligible households.

items: FCI is responsible for supplying food grains to states for central distribution schemes.
TPDS stands for Targeted Public Distribution System, designed to serve eligible households with subsidized food.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Food Corporation of India (FCI) supplies food grains to state governments.
Food grain distribution is managed through the Targeted Public Distribution System (TPDS).
The ultimate objective of TPDS is to ensure subsidized food reaches eligible households.
